ruleDefinitions.name: Enumerate All Information With Whoami.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "whoami.exe" with the "/all" flag

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-all.*"))
